label: lem:shape-radius
scope: The exact scalar radius formula and its strict finite-dimensional bound under positive width and LayerNorm regularization.
excluded: Construction of the centered vector, its norm identity from LayerNorm coordinates, and the global vector gate-diameter consequence.

label: thm:gate-factorization
scope: The scalar triangle-inequality kernel converting two common shape-radius bounds and a nonnegative gate norm into a global pairwise distance bound.
excluded: The implemented LayerNorm factorization, operator-norm evaluation, strict positive-gate inequality, and zero-gate classification.

label: thm:gate-classification
scope: The exact coordinatewise gate difference, constant-coordinate equivalence, zero-gate specialization, and scalar oscillation bound.
excluded: The all-coordinate aggregation and evaluation of the upstream normalized-shape map on physical rows.

label: thm:gate-shape-work
scope: The exact finite diagonal gate-work plus successor-evaluated shape-work identity, nonnegative weighted-square metrics, and the zero-gate specialization.
excluded: Construction of graph shape coefficients from PLDR rows and checkpoint evaluation of the finite terms.

label: thm:shape-secant
scope: The exact finite weighted secant identity and nonnegativity of its quadratic shape charge, with incidence and shape maps supplied inside the contrast coordinates.
excluded: Construction of the PLDR row-shape operator, automatic differentiation, and numerical evaluation of the supplied contrasts.

label: thm:softmax-pairwise
scope: The finite-vocabulary covariance identity in ordered-pair form and its nonnegativity for nonnegative probabilities of unit mass.
excluded: The explicit unordered-pair reindexing, checkpoint logit differentiation, and construction of the signed second jet.

label: thm:observable-dissipation
scope: The exact finite moving-diagonal-metric energy identity and the explicit signed-margin implication giving one-step contraction.
excluded: Identification of the abstract direction with live clipped AdamW moments, checkpoint tensor loading, and numerical margin certification.

label: thm:log-route
scope: Coordinate product energy, factorized nonzero ratios, finite telescoping log decrements, and nodewise zero-factor annihilation.
excluded: Positive-segment indexing, the infinite-tail limit equivalence, absorption after a zero event, and route reopening.

label: thm:observable-block
scope: Chronological affine comparison, geometric decay with zero block forcing, and the exact finite convolution and closed bound under uniform block forcing.
excluded: Arbitrary checkpoint block partitions, vanishing-forcing limit arguments, and empirical construction of block gains and forcing.

label: thm:stacked-generator
scope: Transfer of a supplied uniform pairwise squared bound to a supplied diameter-attaining pair, followed by the finite squared Frobenius stack identity and its cardinality bound from row-to-anchor control.
excluded: The square-root reformulation, graph-energy pairwise estimate, positive-base certification, and application-margin evaluation.
